--- actual_generation_parent
+++ candidate
@@ -19,15 +19,27 @@
 
     d_cur = distance_matrix[current_node][unvisited_nodes]
     d_dep = distance_matrix[depot][unvisited_nodes]
+    demands_u = demands[unvisited_nodes]
+
+    # nearest distance from current node to all feasible nodes
+    nearest = np.min(d_cur)
+
     best = None
     best_score = -np.inf
     for i in range(unvisited_nodes.size):
         node = unvisited_nodes[i]
-        # savings of visiting now rather than from depot on a later trip
-        saving = d_dep[i] + d_dep[i] - distance_matrix[node][depot]
-        # balance proximity and savings; use demand ratio to prefer filling vehicle
-        demand_ratio = demands[node] / (rest_capacity + 1e-12)
-        score = saving - d_cur[i] + 0.1 * demand_ratio
+        demand = demands_u[i]
+        # marginal travel cost to serve this customer now
+        travel_cost = d_cur[i]
+        # return trip cost avoided by serving it now (vs. depot round trip later)
+        return_saving = 2.0 * d_dep[i]
+        # regret: how much worse off we'd be if forced to pick the nearest instead
+        regret = d_cur[i] - nearest
+        # density: demand packed per unit of marginal travel
+        density = demand / (travel_cost + 1e-9)
+        # opportunity cost: relative capacity fraction consumed
+        cap_frac = demand / (rest_capacity + 1e-12)
+        score = return_saving - travel_cost - regret + density + 0.5 * cap_frac
         if score > best_score:
             best_score = score
             best = node

-        node = unvisited_nodes[i]
-        # savings of visiting now rather than from depot on a later trip
-        saving = d_dep[i] + d_dep[i] - distance_matrix[node][depot]

-        if score > best_score:
-            best_score = score
-            best = node
-    return int(best)+    dem = demands[unvisited_nodes]
+
+    # Normalize distances by the max current leg to keep scores in comparable range
+    scale = np.max(d_cur) + 1e-9
+    prox = 1.0 - (d_cur / scale)               # higher = closer
+    fill = dem / (rest_capacity + 1e-9)        # higher = uses capacity
+    # depot-return pressure: prefer nodes whose return leg is short (easier to close route)
+    return_pressure = 1.0 - (d_dep / (np.max(d_dep) + 1e-9))
+
+    # Weighted composite: proximity dominates, filling and closing are secondary
+    score = 1.0 * prox + 0.35 * fill + 0.15 * return_pressure
+
+    # Penalize very small remaining capacity relative to demand to avoid bad fit
+    fit_penalty = np.where(dem > rest_capacity, 10.0, 0.0)
+
+    final = score - fit_penalty
+
+    return int(unvisited_nodes[np.argmax(final)])
